entities.summary: Clinton "Trey" Johnson III is an American-Qatari basketball coach and former professional player who is the associate head coach for the Jackson State Tigers. He played college basketball with the Alcorn State Braves and the Jackson State Tigers in the Southwestern Athletic Conference (SWAC). During his senior year, he won the SWAC Player of the Year award. He has spent much of his professional career with the Bakersfield Jam in the NBA Development League, a minor league basketball organization owned and run by the National Basketball Association (NBA).
